vsm_interpretation: The benchmark directly exercises external/operational evidence -> adaptation option -> persistent capability change -> later operation. The adaptation organization is supplied by A-Evolve and must not be attributed to a task solver by association.

Frozen deployment makes the persistent return-to-capability path explicit and separates durable procedural adaptation from current-episode repair and raw episodic reuse. The Skill Author is benchmark-hosted.

The self-evolving mode closes external harness change plus accumulated experience into persistent adaptation that affects later operation. No unrelated GitHub repository is attached by name similarity.

The benchmark directly converts operating evidence into a persistent executable capability change and then measures later operation under a disjoint future evaluation surface. The S4 owner is the benchmark-defined evolver plus evolving harness organization, not the fixed policy model or a canonical Index harness.
